journeys.name: Stop an Apprenticeship
journeys.description: The employer stops an apprenticeship for a specified reason and confirms the outcome.

journeys.name: Change an Apprentice’s Training Provider
journeys.description: The employer changes the training provider for an apprentice and submits a provider change request.

journeys.name: Handle Apprenticeship That Never Started
journeys.description: The employer records and confirms that an apprenticeship never started.

journeys.name: View and Manage Apprentice Details
journeys.description: The employer reviews an apprentice’s history, updates, or payments from the details view.

journeys.name: Edit Draft Apprenticeship in Cohort
journeys.description: The employer creates or edits a draft apprentice within a cohort and completes necessary details.

journeys.name: Edit an Apprentice’s Option or Version
journeys.description: The employer edits an apprentice’s course option or version, and confirms the change.

journeys.name: Send a Cohort for Approval
journeys.description: The employer completes a draft cohort and submits it for approval, returning to the dashboard.
